#include <iostream>
using namespace std;

const long long MOD = 1000000007LL;

int mod_pow(int base, int exponent)
{
    long long result = 1;
    long long b = base;

    while (exponent > 0)
    {
        if (exponent & 1)
            result = (result * b) % MOD;
        b = (b * b) % MOD;
        exponent >>= 1;
    }

    return (int)result;
}

int main()
{
    long long p, k, q;
    cin >> p >> k;
    q = k;

    if (k == 0)
    {
        cout << mod_pow(p, p - 1);
        return 0;
    }
    if (k == 1)
    {
        cout << mod_pow(p, p);
        return 0;
    }

    int n = 1;
    while (q != 1)
    {
        q = (q * k) % p;
        ++n;
    }

    cout << mod_pow(p, (p - 1) / n);
    return 0;
}
